Overview
Developer / Publisher: Azgames
Release Date: April 2026
Platform: Browser (Desktop, Mobile, Tablet)
Genre: Driving, 3D, action, survival, reflex 
Key Features
Multi-Terrain Getaway: Drive through busy city streets, suburbs, deserts, and ocean routes.
Vehicle Switching: Leap out of your car mid-run to swim across water or pilot boats, airplanes, and gliders.
Characters & Customization: Unlock over 30 unique characters and 90+ total vehicles, including Mythic and Legendary cars.
Support Items & Mini-Games: Collect up to 8 different power-ups and participate in side challenges like F1 racing, zombie battles, and alien encounters.

Shift: Activate nitro boost.
F: Use legendary items or special support buffs.
Right/Left Mouse Click: Aim and fire handguns (dropped by cops).
